name: Black Hole
description: Tasks, a focus timer, a daily notepad and today's calendar for macOS, exposed to AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol.
notes: There is no central endpoint to call. Black Hole's MCP server runs on each user's own Mac and answers only while the app is open. A user turns on AI access in the app, which gives that Mac a permanent address of the form above, and pastes it into their assistant. The token in the path is the credential.
